steps.name: Given user lanuch the application merchant click the merchant module is navigate to respective page.
When merchant enter the mobile number "9876543210" and name "Apex Institute Manager"
And merchant click the passcode button and enter the "123456" and click verify button
And its navigate to merchant page and click course studio and click new course program button
And merchant enters course details for "TeleMarketing" field and select the category
And merchant fix the course tution fee in "2500" and fix the course duration time "1 Month" field
And merchant select the delivery format and "welcome" give overview of course details
And merchant click the add module button and  give module title "Foundation 1" and  time "15 days" duration description "Valid points added"
When merchant give another module title "Foundation 2",duration time "15 days",description "All topic"
And merchant click the publish course button again click the close button and close icon
